probes: SELECT table_name, string_agg(column_name || ':' || data_type || ':' || is_nullable, ', ' ORDER BY ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'edge_bff' AND table_name IN ('payment_orders', 'payment_events') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT conname, pg_get_constraintdef(oid) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'edge_bff.subscriptions'::regclass AND contype = 'c' ORDER BY 1

SELECT t, string_agg(p, ',' ORDER BY p) FILTER (WHERE has_table_privilege('edge_bff_runtime', 'edge_bff.' || t, p)) AS held FROM unnest(ARRAY['payment_orders', 'payment_events']) AS t CROSS JOIN unnest(ARRAY['SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'TRUNCATE']) AS p GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT t, has_table_privilege('public', 'edge_bff.' || t, 'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE') AS any FROM unnest(ARRAY['payment_orders', 'payment_events']) AS t ORDER BY 1
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.payment_orders) AS orders, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.payment_events) AS events
SELECT provider, status, count(*) FROM edge_bff.subscriptions GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
